mentions.name: AI-proof careers leaderboard
mentions.description: A leaderboard that ranks 900+ BLS jobs by AI resilience, built by pulling BLS data and analyzing talks by AI researchers and industry figures, created to cut through the 'AI will take your jobs' hysteria.
mentions.problem: The author was annoyed by the 'AI will take your jobs' hysteria, so built a data-driven ranking of which jobs are resilient to AI.
mentions.source_excerpt:
AI-proof careers leaderboard
